actions.name: check_key
actions.description:
Health Check. Validate an API key and return its organization ID and scopes.

Any valid Sybill API key can call this endpoint.

actions.name: ask_sybill
actions.description:
Ask Sybill. Submit a one-shot question using organization-level Sybill data.

Requires the **Ask Sybill** permission (`ask_sybill` scope). The request waits
up to 60 seconds. A terminal run returns `200 OK`; a run still in progress
returns `202 Accepted` with `Location` and `Retry-After` headers for polling.

actions.name: get_ask_sybill_result
actions.description:
Get Ask Sybill Result. Wait up to 60 seconds for a previously submitted Ask Sybill run.

Requires the **Ask Sybill** permission (`ask_sybill` scope). Terminal runs
return `200 OK`; active runs return `202 Accepted` with polling headers. Runs
remain accessible to the originating organization for 30 days.

actions.name: list_conversations
actions.description:
List Conversations. List organization-visible conversations.

Requires the **Export** permission (`read` scope). Private conversations owned
by individual users are excluded. Results use cursor-based pagination;
`sourceId` accepts a custom source UUID or one of the native meeting-provider
identifiers listed below.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page (1-50)

startedAfter.description: Lower bound for meeting start time (ISO 8601)

startedBefore.description: Upper bound for meeting start time (ISO 8601)

type.description: Filter by meeting type (e.g. EXTERNAL, INTERNAL)

title.description: Filter by meeting title (case-insensitive partial match)

attendees.description: Filter by an attendee. Accepts three shapes: a participant name fragment (e.g. `John`, case-insensitive partial match), a full participant email (e.g. `alice@acme.com`, exact match), or a participant company domain (e.g. `@acme.com` or `acme.com`, exact match against the email domain).

crmName.description: Filter by associated CRM deal or account name (case-insensitive exact-phrase match). Multi-word queries match the full phrase, not individual tokens.

sourceId.description: Filter by conversation origin. Accepts a reserved native string (e.g. `sybill`, `gong`, `chorus`, `fathom`, `grain`, `mindtickle`, `avoma`, `fireflies`, `zoho_meetings`, `uploaded_call`, `uploaded_transcript`, `zoom_phone`, `outreach_dialer`, `nooks_dialer`, `ringcentral_dialer`, `aircall_dialer`, `hubspot_dialer`, `cloudtalk_dialer`), or a public-API ``IngestSource`` UUID to narrow to conversations ingested through that source. `sybill` includes desktop-notetaker recordings. Omitted means all origins.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response

actions.name: import_conversation
actions.description:
Import Conversation. Import a conversation into Sybill.

Requires the **Import** permission (`ingest` scope). Include a non-empty
transcript, a recording URL, or both. A `201 Created` response confirms
acceptance for asynchronous transcription and enrichment; derived fields may
not be available immediately.

actions.name: delete_imported_conversation
actions.description:
Delete Imported Conversation. Soft-delete a conversation previously imported through this API.

Requires the **Import** permission (`ingest` scope). Identify the record with
the custom source UUID and the external ID originally supplied as `id`.

actions.name: get_conversation
actions.description:
Get Conversation. Return the available details for one organization-visible conversation.

Includes the transcript, recordings, and AI-generated summary when present.
Requires the **Export** permission (`read` scope). Private conversations owned
by individual users are excluded.

actions.name: list_deals
actions.description:
List Deals. List CRM deals available to the API key's organization.

Requires the **Export** permission (`read` scope). Results use cursor-based
pagination.

name.description: Filter deals by name (case-insensitive partial match)

stage.description: Filter by pipeline stage name (case-insensitive partial match)

closed.description: Filter by closed status: true for won/lost deals, false for open

owner.description: Filter by deal owner name (case-insensitive partial match)

closeDateBefore.description: Upper bound for close date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2025-06-30T00:00:00Z)

lastActivityBefore.description: Upper bound for last activity date (ISO 8601)

lastActivityAfter.description: Lower bound for last activity date (ISO 8601)

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page (1-50)

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response

actions.name: get_deal
actions.description:
Get Deal. Return the available details for one CRM deal.

Includes its AI-generated summary, CRM autofill suggestions, and contacts when
present. Requires the **Export** permission (`read` scope).

actions.name: list_accounts
actions.description:
List Accounts. List CRM accounts available to the API key's organization.

Requires the **Export** permission (`read` scope). Results use cursor-based
pagination.

name.description: Filter by account name (case-insensitive partial match)

website.description: Filter by website URL (case-insensitive partial match)

owner.description: Filter by owner name or email (case-insensitive partial match)

createdBefore.description: Upper bound for created date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2025-06-30T00:00:00Z)

lastActivityBefore.description: Upper bound for last activity date (ISO 8601)

lastActivityAfter.description: Lower bound for last activity date (ISO 8601)

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page (1-50)

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response

actions.name: get_account
actions.description:
Get Account. Return the available details for one CRM account.

Includes contacts and synced CRM fields when present. Requires the **Export**
permission (`read` scope).

actions.name: list_messages
actions.description:
List Messages. List organization-visible messages from native or custom sources.

Requires the **Export** permission (`read` scope). Private messages owned by
individual users are excluded. Results use cursor-based pagination.

actions.name: import_message
actions.description:
Import Message. Import a message into Sybill.

Requires the **Import** permission (`ingest` scope). A `201 Created` response
confirms acceptance for asynchronous processing; derived fields may not be
available immediately.

actions.name: delete_imported_message
actions.description:
Delete Imported Message. Soft-delete a message previously imported through this API.

Requires the **Import** permission (`ingest` scope). Identify the record with
the custom source UUID and the external ID originally supplied as `id`.

actions.name: get_message
actions.description:
Get Message. Return the available details for one organization-visible message.

Includes its body and attachment metadata. Requires the **Export** permission
(`read` scope). Private messages owned by individual users are excluded.

actions.name: import_row
actions.description:
Import Row. Import a typed custom row.

Requires the **Import** permission (`ingest` scope). Create its object type
first, then ensure each field value matches the object type's schema. A
`201 Created` response confirms acceptance for asynchronous processing.

fieldType.description: Field value types accepted by row ingestion requests.

actions.name: update_imported_row
actions.description:
Update Imported Row. Partially update an imported row.

Requires the **Import** permission (`ingest` scope). The `fields` map follows
RFC 7396 merge-patch behavior: supplied keys replace values, omitted keys
remain unchanged, and `null` deletes a field. `null` values for top-level
fields are ignored.

fieldType.description: Field value types accepted by row ingestion requests.

actions.name: delete_imported_row
actions.description:
Delete Imported Row. Soft-delete an imported row.

Requires the **Import** permission (`ingest` scope). Identify the row with its
custom source UUID and external ID.

actions.name: list_rows
actions.description:
List Rows. List organization-visible custom rows.

Requires the **Export** permission (`read` scope). Private rows owned by
individual users are excluded. Rows accept custom source UUIDs only and use
cursor-based pagination.

actions.name: get_row
actions.description:
Get Row. Return one organization-visible custom row by its Sybill ID.

Requires the **Export** permission (`read` scope). The response shape matches
a row returned by the list endpoint.

actions.name: create_source
actions.description:
Create Source. Create a logical source for records imported into Sybill.

Requires the **Import** permission (`ingest` scope). The source `name` is a
stable machine identifier that must be unique within the organization;
`displayName` is shown in the Sybill UI.

actions.name: list_sources
actions.description:
List Sources. List custom sources in the API key's organization.

Requires the **Export** permission (`read` scope).

actions.name: get_source
actions.description:
Get Source. Return one custom source owned by the API key's organization.

Requires the **Export** permission (`read` scope).

actions.name: update_source
actions.description:
Update Source. Update a source's display name.

Requires the **Import** permission (`ingest` scope). The stable
machine-readable `name` cannot be changed.

actions.name: delete_source
actions.description:
Delete Source. Delete a custom source.

Requires the **Import** permission (`ingest` scope). Deletion prevents future
imports through the source but does not delete records or object types
previously created under it.

actions.name: create_object_type
actions.description:
Create Object Type. Create a typed schema for custom rows within a source.

Requires the **Import** permission (`ingest` scope). Field names must be
unique, and each field definition declares the accepted value type.

fieldType.description: Field value types accepted by row ingestion requests.

actions.name: list_object_types
actions.description:
List Object Types. List row object types in the API key's organization.

Results may be filtered by source. Requires the **Export** permission (`read`
scope).

actions.name: get_object_type
actions.description:
Get Object Type. Return one row object type owned by the API key's organization.

Requires the **Export** permission (`read` scope).

actions.name: update_object_type
actions.description:
Update Object Type. Update an object type's display name or field definitions.

Requires the **Import** permission (`ingest` scope). Supplying
`fieldDefinitions` replaces the complete field schema.

fieldType.description: Field value types accepted by row ingestion requests.

actions.name: delete_object_type
actions.description:
Delete Object Type. Delete an object type.

Requires the **Import** permission (`ingest` scope). Existing rows remain
readable, but new rows and updates can no longer use the deleted type.

actions.name: list_documents
actions.description:
List Documents. List organization-visible documents from native or custom sources.

Includes documents from custom sources, chat uploads, and mailbox attachments.
Requires the **Export** permission (`read` scope). Private documents owned by
individual users are excluded. Results use cursor-based pagination.

actions.name: import_document
actions.description:
Import Document. Import a document.

Requires the **Import** permission (`ingest` scope). Provide exactly one of
`url` or base64-encoded `content`. A `201 Created` response confirms acceptance
for asynchronous conversion and indexing; search and AI features may not
include the document immediately.

actions.name: update_imported_document
actions.description:
Update Imported Document. Partially update an imported document.

Requires the **Import** permission (`ingest` scope). Supplying `url` or
`content` creates a new version and reprocesses the document; omitting both
performs a metadata-only update. The author cannot be changed.

actions.name: delete_imported_document
actions.description:
Delete Imported Document. Soft-delete a document previously imported through this API.

Requires the **Import** permission (`ingest` scope). Identify the document
with its custom source UUID and external ID.

actions.name: get_document
actions.description:
Get Document. Return the available details for one organization-visible document.

Requires the **Export** permission (`read` scope). Private documents owned by
individual users are excluded.
